identity.name: King Seiko KS1969 Automatic
identity.one_liner: The 2022 revival of the King Seiko 44KS line, 39.4mm, 100m water resistance, 6L35 hi-beat movement — Grand Seiko's mid-tier dress line with its own independent design language.

provenance_events.description: Seiko launches the King Seiko KS1969 line as a 39.4mm dress watch with the 6L35 movement, faceted case, and a dial that updates the 1969 44KS design language.

narrative.story: King Seiko is Seiko's mid-tier dress line, with a separate design language from Grand Seiko. The 2022 revival uses the SJE109 case — 39.4mm, 100m water resistance, faceted bezel and lugs — paired with the 6L35 hi-beat movement.
narrative.collector_notes: The SJE109 wears slightly larger than its size suggests because of the faceted lugs. The 6L35 is the same family as the 6L37 (hi-beat 36,000 vph) — 45-hour reserve, -10/+15 seconds/day accuracy.
